notes.title: New update v1.2 released
notes.notes:
Based on the community feedback and suggestions from Jim Sterling's lets play video, we are rolling out a new update. 

Improvement Details
--------------------------------

- Graphics improved: Anti aliasing & soft shadow implemented

- UI improved: Skill upgrade arrows included, making it easier to figure out how to upgrade the Predator

- UX improved: All skills unlocked by default rather than going through them one by one.

- Controls improved: Coming out of screenshot mode with Esc key instead of pause button.

- Game dynamics: Defcon levels go up quicker, making it easier to crunch through lower defcon levels. 

- Rewards: NPCs have more rewards including diamonds. Gathering diamonds for unlocking skills is much faster.

We appreciate the players taking time and effort to give us their feedback. We will be constantly monitoring the gameplay experiences and roll out updates based on the community inputs. 

Thanks

notes.title: Major update released
notes.notes:
So many wonderful things have happened in last 12 hours since the release of Predator Simulator. It is so entertaining to see that people are actually playing my game :-) We received two negative reviews and I had personally reached out to these players to find out about their cause of disappointment and based on their input, a new update has been published just now.

Update v1.1:

1) Character unlock function completely removed. Now the characters will show up as players progress through the defcon levels. This way, the player can focus on the fun factor rather than grinding for "Diamonds". Nobody likes grinding!

2) Ratio of mission rewards and amount of "Diamonds" required to unlock skills has been fixed. So, players can unlock skills easily enough to enjoy the game progression without playing the same mission over and over.

3) Fixed the dullness of the city that was caused by the lack of variation of population. Now, a dozen different types of preys/NPCs come out much earlier in the defcon levels.

4) Ragdoll animation glitch improved. Ragdoll animations are processed in the GPU, so the better GPU you have the smoother they will look and will not glitch out causing chaotic mess :-D

I hope you guys will enjoy the game even more now that the "Grinding" part is removed completely. Please submit the bugs in the forum's "Bug Report" section so we can take care of it ASAP. Happy gaming!
